en: The postcard features monochrome illustrations of several landmarks in Bad Pyrmont, Germany, including the Brunnen (a pavilion structure), Schloss (a castle or palace), Helenenquelle (Helen's spring), and the Post building. The images are drawn in a historical, Old World style depicting late 19th-century architecture, with trees and people shown in period clothing. There is significant handwritten text on the front, and postal markings with stamps on the back, including 'Deutsche Reichspost' and a cancellation mark from 'ROTTFERDAM', as well as a large 'BAD PYRMONT' title.
